_email_comment: optional — omit to register without email (no expiry warnings from LE)

targets.name: my-idrac

targets._comment: GL.iNet KVM -- KVMD API, uses cert.pem (leaf only)
targets.name: my-kvm

targets._comment: TrueNAS Scale -- WebSocket API, uses fullchain.pem
targets.name: my-nas

targets._comment: Supermicro IPMI -- X10 or X11, uses fullchain.pem
targets.name: my-ipmi

targets._comment: Reolink camera -- requires RSA cert and a single leaf cert (cert.pem, never fullchain.pem); connect by IP, long hostnames break some models
targets.name: my-camera

targets._comment: Brother printer -- requires RSA cert; pip install cryptography on the host
targets.name: office-printer

targets._comment: Proxmox VE -- REST API on port 8006, uses fullchain.pem
targets._verify_ports_comment: verify_ports is optional (default [8006]); add 443 if an nginx on the PVE host serves the same cert -- see proxmox-nginx-reload/
targets.name: my-proxmox

targets._comment: Docker Compose -- restarts listed services, verify_host needed for cert check
targets.name: my-caddy

targets._comment: Caddy over SSH: key then full chain on stdin; receiver installs and reloads, issuer verifies TLS by hostname. Enroll the receiver and pin its SSH host key first.
targets.name: my-caddy-lxc
targets.command: cat "$KEY_FILE" "$CERT_FILE" | ssh -i /etc/letsencrypt/caddy-deploy-key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 cert-receiver@caddy.example.com install
